## Checklist

- [ ] Commit title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) format (`feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, etc.)
- [ ] `go test ./...` passes (if `api/` or `goopy/` changed)
- [ ] `pnpm run test` passes (if `web/` changed)
- [ ] Updated docs / architecture notes if behavior changed
- [ ] No unrelated changes included
